neighbours.label: the word-initial fragment (' f', ' F', ' bl', ' Bl') of a word the tokenizer splits into pieces (f|ash|ions, bl|azon|ry, F|ajas), not f/bl words that are whole tokens
fire: Every spring the boutique on Main Street displays new fashions in its window.

The book explains the rules of blazonry for beginners.
La tienda vende Fajas moldeadoras y ropa interior de control.

In heraldry, the Blazon of a shield names its colours first.
